parsed.post: Reverting the latest experiment (0.862) as it regressed from our best (0.834). The attempt to increase TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE likely reduced the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute window, leading to insufficient convergence. I'm reverting to 692c13d and will now try a more granular reduction in MATRIX_LR to find a more stable peak.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit and lowering learning rate while increasing warmup to ensure smoother convergence and prevent the instability seen in recent attempts.
